items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: And Roy playing drummer, he was a good drummer.

ctx.x: He had left the clarinet alone at that time.
He had two altos in that band. Two altos. And then they had old man Kimball playing bass. Kimball's daddy. Yeah, Kimball's daddy. And Roy playing drummer, he was a good drummer.
Roy was a good drummer. That's the drummer he used to play with Sam Marvins.
